pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-05.png with Read and looked at it before reading any other document. The image loaded and was readable. It shows 4 panels: a wide top panel, a middle row of two, and a wide bottom panel. There are placeholders for ananya and ravi. In P2 and P3 one person's position is shown only as a dot marker with no box.
pages.observation: My reading order was P1, Ananya (left): 'Hello, Ravi. Tell me what brings you in.', with Ravi on the right. Next came P2, Ravi: 'I've been feeling tired lately.', whose tail points to his box. Then P3 caption: 'Technology supports the workflow. The conversation stays human.' (Ananya's box). Last was P4, Ananya: 'We'll go through your concerns and decide the right next steps together.', with Ravi on the right. Ananya stays left and Ravi right across the panels, so the left-right staging is consistent and the exchange reads naturally. Issues: (1) In P2, Ananya appears only as a marker at the far left with no face box. In P3, Ravi appears only as a marker at the right panel edge with no box. It is unclear whether these faces are visible, offscreen or cut off, and this needs to be decided and recorded. (2) In P1 and P4 the balloons cover Ananya's placeholder label and sit right against her box, which could cover her face. (3) The P3 narrator caption interrupts the doctor-patient exchange with a slogan. It reads as an advertising aside, not a story beat. (4) Ravi's symptom ('tired') gets no specific follow-up, and Ananya's reply is generic. This is acceptable if it matches the source, but the exchange feels thin.
